subject: the economic machine Dula intends to observe, and how much of it it can see

types.STOCK: a level at a moment, changed only by flows
types.PRICE: what one unit costs, or what it is valued at
types.QUANTITY: how many units there are, in physical or count terms
types.RATIO: one magnitude over another; meaningless without its denominator
types.CAPACITY: the maximum throughput that is possible
types.UTILIZATION: the share of capacity actually in use

type_refusals.STOCK/FLOW: A level is not a rate. Adding a stock to a flow adds a quantity to a speed.
type_refusals.QUANTITY/CAPACITY: How many exist is not how many could be served. A count is not a maximum.
type_refusals.CAPACITY/UTILIZATION: A maximum is not a share of itself.
type_refusals.PRICE/QUANTITY: A price is per unit; a quantity is of units. Their product is a flow of spending and neither of them is that product.
type_refusals.RATIO/QUANTITY: A ratio has no magnitude of its own. Summing ratios over geographies or periods produces a number with no referent.

forbidden_operations.SUM_OF_RATIOS: Ratios do not add. A population-weighted mean of shares is a different quantity from their sum and must be named as such.
forbidden_operations.STOCK_PLUS_FLOW: A level plus a rate is not a quantity.
forbidden_operations.MEAN_OF_UTILIZATIONS_AS_CAPACITY: Averaging utilisation does not recover capacity.
forbidden_operations.INDEX_TIMES_INDEX: Two indices on different bases have no product. Rebase first, and say so.
forbidden_operations.COMPOSITE_MACHINE_SCORE: There is no single number for how well a machine is observed. Coverage is reported per element and never totalled.

authored.HOUSEHOLD: System of National Accounts households and nonprofit institutions serving households
authored.NONFIN_NONCORP: nonfinancial noncorporate business — partnerships, sole proprietorships, most small firms
authored.FINANCIAL: depository institutions and other financial intermediaries

added.CENTRAL_BANK: The authored set folds the monetary authority into FINANCIAL. §N requires a money and prices machine whose policy instrument is not a bank's decision.
added.NO_SECTOR: A price sits on nobody's balance sheet. Forcing it onto one would invent a position.
added.SECTOR_UNRESOLVED: Needed and not decided. An honest state, never a default.

identities.name: Noncorporate business balance sheet
identities.statement: net worth = total assets - total liabilities
identities.why_this_sector: The firms Dula studies are overwhelmingly noncorporate. The corporate aggregate answers a different question.
identities.forbids: reading a rise in noncorporate net worth as a rise in assets. It is equally consistent with liabilities falling.

check.finding: Net worth is BELOW assets minus liabilities in every one of the 305 quarters published since 1945. The residual is 130,196 million as of 2026-04-01, 0.42% of assets, and it has grown monotonically. A term in this balance sheet is not named by the three published series.
check.what_this_is_not: This is not evidence against the identity. An identity cannot be contradicted by data. It is evidence that the three series do not span the balance sheet.
check.unknown: The third term. Until it is named, no decomposition of noncorporate net worth into assets and liabilities is complete.

identities.name: New Mexico output: price times quantity
identities.statement: nominal output = real output x implicit price deflator
identities.why_this_sector: An output aggregate sits on no one's balance sheet.
identities.forbids: reading growth in nominal state output as growth in what New Mexico produces. This is the identity Phase 7A named as absent (05.2: 'spending = price x quantity is NOT a held identity'), and it is the reason that gap mattered.

check.finding: New Mexico's nominal output rose 191% between 1997 and 2025. Real output rose 78% and prices rose 63%. Price accounts for 46% of the nominal growth — closer to half of it than to a third.
check.what_this_is_not: Not a finding about New Mexico's economy relative to anywhere else. The deflator is a state-level implicit deflator and no other state is read here.

identities.name: Household disposable income
identities.why_this_sector: It is the household's own budget constraint.
identities.unit: mixed: two chained-dollar series and one current-dollar series
identities.forbids: treating a rise in the saving rate as a rise in income.
identities.audits: world_model/dynamics.yaml FL_HH_SAVING.accounting states: 'disposable income = consumption + saving. The model observes all three and can check it.' Phase 10I ran that check.

check.finding: Income and consumption are held in chained 2017 dollars (DSPIC96, PCEC96); saving is held in current dollars (PMSAVE). Differencing them leaves 509 billion as of 2026-07-01, which is not an accounting discrepancy. It is a unit mismatch.
check.corrects: world_model/dynamics.yaml FL_HH_SAVING.accounting asserts that the model 'observes all three and can check it'. On the series the model holds, it cannot: two are real and one is nominal. The identity is sound; the claim about checkability was not.
check.what_would_fix_it: Nominal disposable personal income, or a real saving series. Phase 10I derives the former rather than acquiring it: see ID_HH_BURDEN.
check.type_rule_that_catches_it: A current-dollar flow and a chained-dollar flow are not the same QUANTITY and may not be differenced. See FORBIDDEN_OPS.

identities.name: Household debt service burden
identities.statement: burden = (debt / income) x (required payment per dollar of debt)
identities.why_this_sector: The constraint falls on the household's own income.
identities.forbids: reading a falling debt burden as cheaper debt. A burden is a stock times a price and either can move.
identities.derives: Nominal disposable income is not held. It is DERIVED as saving / (saving rate / 100), which recovers the denominator BEA used. The recipe is checked against the 2017 chain base.

derivation.why_it_validates: If the derivation recovers the right nominal denominator, dividing it by the chained series must give 1.00 in the base year. It does.

check.finding: The household debt service burden fell from 15.85% of income at its 2007 peak to 11.11% in 2026, a fall of 4.73 points. The decomposition says which term moved. Debt fell from 1.37 to 0.91 times income; on its own that would have taken the burden to 10.53%, which is 5.32 points below the peak — more than the whole observed fall. The required payment per dollar of debt rose from 11.5% to 12.2% and gave 0.58 points back. Deleveraging did all of the work and the price of the debt worked against it.
check.what_this_is_not: The payment rate is NOT an interest rate. TDSP measures required payments, which include scheduled principal, so this term is amortisation and interest together. Reading it as a rate would overstate the cost of credit.
check.distribution_unknown: A sector aggregate. It cannot say what share of households face a binding constraint, and the mean falling is consistent with a tail worsening.

circuits.name: Household circuit
circuits.question: Where does household income come from, what is taken out of it, what is left, and what does what is left do next?

legs.step: debt service claims income before anything else

boundary: Income can be earned outside the place and spent inside it, and the reverse. At national scale this is small; at regional scale it is the whole question, and the model has no regional version of any leg here.
circuits.known_gap: No distribution. Every leg is an aggregate over about 130 million households, so the model cannot say which households face the constraint L9 and L10 describe — and for a constraint, that is most of what matters.

circuits.name: Firm circuit
circuits.question: A firm holds productive assets, produces, earns a surplus, and decides what to do with it. What comes back to the assets?

legs.step: investment adds to the productive asset stock

boundary: Distribution leaves the firm sector and need not stay in the country, let alone the place. FL_DISTRIBUTION's far end is the household sector at national scale; WHERE the holder is, is not observed by any series in this model.
circuits.known_gap: The investment decision's trigger is an expectation, and this model holds no expectation object. CAPACITY_UTILIZATION (WR102) is the only observable trigger it has, and it covers manufacturing, mining and utilities only.

circuits.name: Capital allocation circuit
circuits.question: Saving exists somewhere. How does it reach a productive asset, on what terms, and who ends up holding the claim?

legs.step: the price of risk for market borrowers
an allocation decision by a lender
legs.why: actor AC_BANK exists; a decision is not observed

legs.step: or an equity claim is created or retired
and reinvests, spends, or moves it
legs.why: actor AC_ASSET_OWNER exists; a decision is not observed

boundary: Claims cross borders in both directions; ST_ROW_NET_POSITION records the net position and FL_EXTERNAL_FINANCING, the flow that would change it, is NOT ACQUIRED.
At a regional scale this circuit is open at every leg and the model has no regional version of any of them.
circuits.known_gap: L11 is the leg the whole regional project turns on and the least observed in the model. Ownership and domicile are different, section 10 asks for the difference, and no series held here supplies it.

circuits.name: Credit circuit
circuits.question: A lender's balance sheet, the conditions it sets, the borrowing that follows, and what comes back to the balance sheet.

legs.step: conditions reach the quantity of claims created
credit is created, with its matched deposit
performance changes what the lender will write next

boundary: Non-bank lenders are named (AC_NONBANK_LENDER) and not observed. Where they substitute for banks, this circuit's L4 does not bind and the model cannot see it.
circuits.known_gap: L5 to L7 is the weakest join. The credit flow is NET, and it cannot be told whether new claims financed spending, refinanced old claims, or bought back equity.

circuits.name: Government circuit
circuits.question: Tax and borrowing become transfers, purchases and public investment, which change income and the tax base.

legs.step: purchases and public investment reach firms
income and the tax base change

boundary: Federal resources enter a place from outside it; that is the dominant fiscal fact for this region and it is the reverse of a closed circuit.
circuits.known_gap: L8 has no relationship at all: nothing in the model connects public spending back to the tax base. There is also no GOVERNMENT ACTOR — every decision in this circuit is taken by a body the model cannot name.

circuits.name: Trade circuit
circuits.question: Imports leave payment, exports bring it, and imported inputs enter production.

legs.step: imported input cost enters domestic producer prices
the tariff regime as a quantity, not an announcement

boundary: This circuit SHOULD NOT close at national scale and certainly not at regional scale. It is open by construction, and the boundary stock is the point.
circuits.known_gap: L5 has no variable: DTWEXBGS is acquired and nothing in the model can reference it. L7's flow is NOT ACQUIRED and the stock it changes moves mostly by revaluation anyway.

circuits.name: Physical production circuit
circuits.question: Energy, materials, land, water, labour, capital and knowledge become output.

legs.why: DELIVERABLE_WATER_NNM is registered and not observed

legs.step: output becomes intermediate input to further production
legs.why: the leg requires a relationship and names none; circuits.yaml records the gap rather than the object

boundary: Energy and materials arrive from outside the place. This circuit is open at the input end by construction.
circuits.known_gap: L8 IS MISSING AND CANNOT BE SUPPLIED BY A SINGLE RELATIONSHIP. Output returns to input demand through the input-output structure of production -- which industries buy what from which -- and this model holds no input-output representation of any kind. WR137 states one strand of it (production consumes electricity) and one strand is not the structure. This is the machine that WORKS in this model and it is a chain, not a circuit, and closing it properly means acquiring and representing a use table. That is a larger decision than a leg.

circuits.name: Business dynamics circuit
circuits.question: Firms form, capitalise, operate, survive or not, and their ownership and capability consequences.

legs.why: actor AC_OPERATOR exists; a decision is not observed
the leg requires a relationship and names none; circuits.yaml records the gap rather than the object

boundary: A business can be sold to an owner outside the place. That is the RDM's central concern and this circuit cannot represent it.
circuits.known_gap: Three legs have no relationship. The actor exists and the decisions it controls govern no flow, which the actor registry records rather than hides.

circuits.name: Housing and real estate circuit
circuits.question: Land, entitlement, finance, construction, occupancy, payment, value, and what that value does next.

legs.why: US_HOUSING_DEMAND is registered and not observed

legs.step: price acts back on the demand that produced it

boundary: Construction materials and labour come from outside the place; capital for development frequently does too.
circuits.known_gap: Land and entitlement are absent entirely. The regional housing stock (L5) has flows that are NOT OBSERVED, because permits do not cover the unincorporated places in the study area.

circuits.name: Technology and knowledge circuit
circuits.question: Knowledge becomes invention, investment, adoption, changed process, changed productivity, competition and further investment.

legs.why: the leg requires a variable and names none; circuits.yaml records the gap rather than the object
the leg requires a variable and names none; circuits.yaml records the gap rather than the object
the leg requires a relationship and names none; circuits.yaml records the gap rather than the object

circuits.known_gap: The exam scored technology 0 of 11. Four legs now have objects and four do not. ADOPTION -- L4, the leg everything turns on -- still has none, because nothing published observes whether a technology bought is a technology used. WR134 stands next to that hole rather than filling it, and says so: its own contested note is that the gap between buying and using is where the whole productivity argument lives.

circuits.name: Labour and demographic circuit
circuits.question: Population becomes labour force, employment, wages, household formation, and migration back into the labour force.

legs.step: income supports household formation and consumption
demand draws people into the labour force

boundary: People leave and arrive. At regional scale that is the dominant term and the model has no regional migration object at all.
circuits.known_gap: L8 is missing. Ageing appears only as NM_AGE_65_SHARE acting on the state labour force, and migration, which is the larger term, has no representation.

circuits.name: Natural resource circuit
circuits.question: A resource stock, its availability, its allocation and use, and what that use does to future availability.

legs.why: DELIVERABLE_WATER_NNM is registered and not observed

legs.step: substitution to groundwater when surface water fails
depletion changes what can be delivered next

boundary: Water arrives as precipitation from outside the modelled system and leaves by sublimation and evapotranspiration. It is open at both ends by physics, and the leaks are named.
circuits.known_gap: L7 now EXISTS as a mechanism (WR130) and is not observed: pumping is not metered in any public series and the aquifer stock is NOT ACQUIRED at study-area resolution. The circuit returns in the model and the quantity that would make the return real is missing, which is a different and more useful state than a leg with nothing behind it.

cycles.name: Fuel cost, order minimums and route density
cycles.why_not_closed: Every step after cost per stop is an unobserved parameter. The loop cannot even be started: P02 stops the first hop.

cycles.name: Price, demand destruction and price pressure
cycles.why_not_closed: No consumption or inventory series is held (EIA stocks not acquired), so neither the demand response nor the buffer can be observed. This is the clearest case where a missing stock makes a standard balancing loop untestable.

delays.why: conservation is immediate at the margin; fleet and vehicle changes take years

cycles.name: Price, producer and refiner incentive, supply
cycles.why_not_closed: Refinery utilization and production are NOT ACQUIRED. The model cannot distinguish a price that called forth supply from one that did not.

delays.why: refinery runs respond in weeks within capacity; new supply takes years

cycles.name: Local production, processor utilization and unit cost
cycles.why_not_closed: No regional utilization or unit-cost observation exists. IH04 is an untested hypothesis.

cycles.name: Input cost, application rates, yield and supply
cycles.why_not_closed: No regional application-rate or yield-response evidence; the regional expense shares are observed only in census years.

delays.why: a season to change application, another to see yield and supply

cycles.name: Asset value, collateral and credit
cycles.why_not_closed: The forward arc (prices → credit) can be measured; the return arc (credit → prices) cannot be separated from income, supply and migration with the series held.

cycles.name: Rates, debt service and demand
nodes: debt service on new and refinanced debt
cycles.why_not_closed: The rates → mortgage-rate arc is strong (r = 0.84 at lag 0). The arc from mortgage rates to building is NOT supported by measurement here, and the return arc to policy is a committee decision this model does not model.

cycles.name: Credit performance and lender behaviour
cycles.why_not_closed: Both observables exist (delinquency and the tightening survey), so the forward arc is testable; the return arc from tightening to future delinquency is confounded by the cycle itself.

cycles.name: Price, building incentive and supply
cycles.why_not_closed: Whether supply responds in the study area is exactly XU01, which is open. The loop is tested nationally in this phase and is never applied to the region.

delays.why: starts to completions alone is months to years

cycles.name: Materials price, substitution and demand
cycles.why_not_closed: No substitution evidence is held at any geography in this model.

cycles.name: Wages, in-migration and labour supply
cycles.why_not_closed: No regional wage or migration response is observed, and the housing condition makes the loop dependent on SC01's question.

cycles.name: Drought, fuel condition, fire and watershed
cycles.why_not_closed: The 2022 fire is documented and its housing loss is recorded by the Housing domain, but no post-fire hydrological monitoring series is held, so the arc from burn scar back to water condition is unobserved here.

bubble_gate.refusal: Dula cannot state whether US housing is a bubble. It observes 2 of the 6 conditions that distinguish one from an expensive market, and the 4 it cannot observe are the ones that do the distinguishing.
bubble_gate.why: Four of the six conditions are facts about buyers: what they believe, who they are, and what they borrowed to buy. Dula holds no expectations object — v0.2 named that a blind spot and nothing since has filled it — and it holds no transaction-level data in any market. These are not gaps that acquisition closes: an aggregate cannot tell you who bought or on what terms. The aggregate loan-to-value the debt decomposition derives is a ratio across the whole housing stock, which is a different quantity from the leverage taken on by the people buying now.
bubble_gate.what_can_be_said_instead: The level and direction of the price, the level and direction of the credit behind it, and the leverage per unit of collateral — each on its own terms, with no word that implies a future.

boundary.finding: Every chain that leaves a world or national condition stops at a variable the model registered because it needed it and does not observe. The last observed node is national or multi-state in every case; the first unobserved node is the one that would make the reading local.
boundary.what_this_is_a_boundary_of: The CURRENT REGISTERED GRAPH, not the economy. Of the objects that stop these walks, all are registered variables the model needs and does not observe. That is a fact about Dula's coverage. Whether the economy itself has a discontinuity in the same place is a separate question this census cannot answer.
boundary.the_stopping_objects_in_this_graph: In the walks this model currently supports, the stopping objects are regional parameters of the kind circuits.yaml and causal.yaml already call regional transmission gates. That is a description of what is registered, and the registry is heavily weighted toward price mechanisms, so it is not evidence that transmission is principally a price phenomenon.
boundary.consequence: On the paths this model currently registers, Dula can state a direction from the world to a place and cannot state a magnitude. National data would not supply the missing parameters, because the parameters are regional. Whether other paths exist that the model has not registered is not settled here.

adversarial.attack: '39 prices and 6 stocks' misrepresents the model: the dynamic layer holds stocks separately.

adversarial.attack: An OBSERVED circuit leg sounds like a verified leg. It only means a file exists.
adversarial.finding: Correct, and the vocabulary now says so: LEG_STATES defines OBSERVED as 'the object exists and a series stands behind it'. Whether the series is the right measure of the step is a separate question this census does not ask.

adversarial.attack: The noncorporate balance sheet residual is a wrong series triple, not a missing term.
adversarial.finding: Cannot be settled here. The residual is positive in all 305 quarters and grows monotonically, which is consistent with an unnamed term and also with the three series being drawn from different tables. The identity is reported as DOES_NOT_CLOSE with the residual, which is what this phase can honestly say.

adversarial.attack: 'Roughly two fifths of New Mexico's nominal growth is price' is arithmetic by subtraction.
adversarial.finding: The attack was right. Percentage changes do not apportion by subtraction. The log decomposition gives price 46% of nominal growth, closer to half than to two fifths, and the finding now states the computed share.

adversarial.attack: 'The entire improvement in the debt burden is a smaller stock' is loose.
adversarial.finding: Right, and wrong in an interesting direction. Holding the payment rate at its peak and moving only the stock gives 10.53%, which is 5.32 points below the peak against an observed fall of 4.74. The stock did more than the whole fall and the price gave 0.58 points back.

adversarial.attack: Dula cannot observe whether leverage is lengthening, so the bubble gate overstates what it sees.
adversarial.finding: The claim that leverage lengthening was observable has been removed. It rested on an aggregate mortgage-to-housing-value ratio, which is a stock over a stock across the whole housing stock and says nothing about the leverage taken on by current buyers. The gate now reads 2 of 6.

adversarial.attack: The boundary finding is cherry-picked: six entry points were chosen because they would stop.
adversarial.finding: Every one of the 107 registered variables was walked. 2 reach a geography at state resolution or finer and 0 reach a county or the study area. The two that get furthest both land on a multi-state refining region that includes New Mexico without being it. The finding is not about the six entries; it is universal.

adversarial.attack: FED_RECEIPTS reaching nothing is an adjacency bug.
adversarial.finding: It appears in exactly one registered relationship and has no outbound edge. The walk finds nothing because there is nothing: in the state most exposed to federal spending, federal receipts is an observed terminal node.

adversarial.attack: The orphan count ignores the dynamic model.
adversarial.finding: It did, and it was wrong by one. machine_position now searches dynamics.yaml as well; the count is 18.

adversarial.attack: '41 variables are noncorporate' is presented as a finding and is an artefact of a default.
adversarial.finding: Correct. Four machines carry NONFIN_NONCORP as a machine-level default, so the count describes the default and not the data. Every variable records `sector_is_machine_default`, and 8 of 107 sectors are individually decided. The aggregate is not reported as a finding anywhere.

adversarial.attack: 70 of 82 elements held means the machine is 85% observed.
adversarial.finding: It means nothing of the kind and the phase does not say it. The eighty-two elements are not commensurable — a policy rate and a CRE maturity schedule are not interchangeable units — and FORBIDDEN_OPS names COMPOSITE_MACHINE_SCORE for this reason. Coverage is reported per element.

adversarial.attack: Four identities were chosen because two of them fail, which flatters the phase's honesty.
adversarial.finding: Not settleable from inside. The four were chosen for sector relevance: the sector Dula studies, the state it studies, and the household budget constraint twice. Two close and two do not. A reader who thinks the set was picked can check it against the 95 registered edges, of which 17 are typed IDENTITY and none was excluded here.

adversarial.attack: Refusing a master cycle label is evasion dressed as rigour.
adversarial.finding: The refusal predates this phase and is recorded with its reason in docs/phase7a/04_genuine_gaps.md 04.5, which declined to build a policy-phase sequence because a sequence of phases is an archetype assertion. What is offered instead is each circuit's own state and a configuration object with nine dimensions that are not netted.

adversarial.attack: The derived nominal income is circular: the burden it decomposes was published against a denominator this phase invented.
adversarial.finding: The derivation is validated against the chain base rather than against the burden. If it recovers the right current-dollar denominator, dividing it by the chained series must give 1.00 in 2017. It gives 1.0001. Nothing in that test uses TDSP.

adversarial.attack: Cutting a chain at the first unobserved link makes every chain look short.
adversarial.finding: It makes every chain as long as it is observed, which is the question. A chain continued past an unobserved link is not a longer chain; it is an unobserved one. Each walk also reports the furthest attempt that stopped, so the link where it fails is named rather than hidden.

adversarial.attack: Two chains reach PADD III, so Dula does reach New Mexico.
adversarial.finding: PADD III is a refining region spanning the Gulf Coast and the southwest. A price for it is not a price for New Mexico, and treating it as one is the substitution PIERCE-04 and the regeography rule exist to prevent. The county-reaching count is zero.

adversarial.attack: The sector requirement lists were written to be mostly satisfiable.
adversarial.finding: Authored by this phase, so not self-certifiable. The one check available is whether any sector comes out badly, and one does: commercial real estate holds 2 of 6. A reader should treat the lists as a judgement to argue with.

adversarial.attack: DECLARED_ABSENT versus MISSING is a cosmetic distinction.
adversarial.finding: It separates an authoring error from an honest gap, and the counts show why that matters: 0 legs name an object that does not exist and 6 legs were written with the object deliberately left blank. Without the distinction the second group would read as broken references.

adversarial.attack: Vintage class is assigned by keyword matching on free text.
adversarial.finding: It is, and that is crude. It classifies 81 series by what the authored `source` string contains. The conclusion it supports does not depend on the split being exact: no vintage history is held for ANY series, so the claim form it forbids is forbidden regardless of class.

adversarial.attack: 'Acquire nothing' is a way of not doing the work.
adversarial.finding: Four acquisition candidates are named with what each one blocks. The reason none was fetched is that the three cheapest closures — 3 by linkage and 5 by derivation — need no data at all, and acting on them means editing world_model/, which IN19 holds byte-identical outside a named pierce. The constraint is governance and the phase says so rather than downloading something easier.

reading.lede: Dula observes 57 of 99 legs of the twelve circuits it says make up an economy, across 107 typed variables. What it cannot do is cross the last step into a place: of every walk the registered graph allows, none reaches a county.
defining: 39 of its 107 variables are prices and 6 are stocks; the model's other stocks live in the dynamic layer, which holds 27.
45 variables are observed above the geography their machine reasons about, and 16 are named and unobserved.
5 of the twelve circuits contain no actor at all, so every transition in them reads as arithmetic.

beats.claim: Dula can name the economic machine it observes, and it observes a little over half of it.
beats.says: 107 variables are typed and placed, 57 of 99 circuit legs have a series behind them, and 36 legs name an object the model holds and nothing measures.
beats.because: Coverage is counted per element. Nine kinds of element are counted here and none is weighted against another, so there is no total and no percentage of the economy.
beats.consequence: Every reading below is bounded by this. Where a circuit leg is unobserved, claims that run through it are directional at best.

beats.claim: Dula can follow the world to the edge of New Mexico and no further.
beats.says: Walking every registered relationship from every one of the 107 variables, two walks reach a geography finer than national and both land on a multi-state refining region. None reaches a county or the study area.
beats.because: Each walk stops at the first link whose two ends are not both observed. In every case the last observed node is national and the first unobserved one is the regional parameter that would convert a national price into what someone here pays.
beats.rival: That the walk is too strict, and a chain continued past an unobserved link would reach further. It would — but it would not be observed. The furthest stopping attempt is reported for each entry so the failing link is named rather than hidden.
beats.consequence: Dula can state a direction from the world to a place and not a magnitude. No amount of national data changes that: the missing objects are regional and mostly unpublished.

beats.claim: Two of the model's four accounting identities do not close, and both failures are findings rather than errors.
beats.says: Noncorporate net worth sits below assets minus liabilities in all 305 published quarters, now by 130,196 million or 0.4238% of assets. The household budget identity cannot be checked at all on the series held: two terms are chained dollars and one is current dollars.
beats.because: An identity cannot be contradicted by data. Where it does not close, either a term is unobserved or the specification is wrong, and both are facts about the model.
beats.rival: That the noncorporate residual is a wrong series triple rather than a missing term. This phase cannot settle that and says so.
beats.consequence: The readings an identity exists to forbid are not actually forbidden while it cannot be checked. That is what makes an unclosed identity worth reporting.
beats.unknown: dynamics.yaml states that the model 'observes all three and can check' the household budget identity. On the series it holds, it cannot. world_model/dynamics.yaml FL_HH_SAVING.accounting asserts that the model 'observes all three and can check it'. On the series the model holds, it cannot: two are real and one is nominal. The identity is sound; the claim about checkability was not.

beats.claim: The household debt burden fell because the stock shrank, not because the debt got cheaper.
beats.says: The household debt service burden fell from 15.85% of income at its 2007 peak to 11.11% in 2026, a fall of 4.73 points. The decomposition says which term moved. Debt fell from 1.37 to 0.91 times income; on its own that would have taken the burden to 10.53%, which is 5.32 points below the peak — more than the whole observed fall. The required payment per dollar of debt rose from 11.5% to 12.2% and gave 0.58 points back. Deleveraging did all of the work and the price of the debt worked against it.
beats.because: A burden is a stock times a price. Nominal disposable income, which neither term is published against here, is derived from two held series and validated against the 2017 chain base.
beats.rival: That the derived denominator makes the decomposition circular. It does not: the derivation is checked against the chain base, a test that uses no part of the burden series.
beats.consequence: Reporting the burden alone would have supported the opposite reading. Ten faces of this debt are reported and 2 of them are unknown.
beats.unknown: The distribution. Every series here is a sector aggregate, and a falling mean is fully consistent with a worsening tail.

beats.claim: Nearly half of New Mexico's output growth since 1997 is price, not product.
beats.says: New Mexico's nominal output rose 191% between 1997 and 2025. Real output rose 78% and prices rose 63%. Price accounts for 46% of the nominal growth — closer to half of it than to a third.
beats.because: This is the identity Phase 7A named as missing — 'spending = price x quantity is NOT a held identity' — and closing it required resolving which of the model's variables are prices and which are quantities, which is what the type work above did.
beats.consequence: A nominal state aggregate may not be read as what New Mexico produces. The identity's whole value is the reading it forbids.

beats.claim: Dula cannot say whether any market is a bubble, and the reason is structural.
beats.says: Of six conditions that separate a bubble from an expensive market, Dula observes two. The four it cannot observe are facts about buyers: what they believe, who they are, and what they borrowed.
beats.because: Four of the six conditions are facts about buyers: what they believe, who they are, and what they borrowed to buy. Dula holds no expectations object — v0.2 named that a blind spot and nothing since has filled it — and it holds no transaction-level data in any market. These are not gaps that acquisition closes: an aggregate cannot tell you who bought or on what terms. The aggregate loan-to-value the debt decomposition derives is a ratio across the whole housing stock, which is a different quantity from the leverage taken on by the people buying now.
beats.consequence: The word is refused rather than hedged. What is offered instead is the price, the credit behind it, and the named conditions that are not visible.

beats.claim: Twenty attacks were run against this phase's own output and nine of them changed it.
beats.because: Four claims were restated, four were withdrawn, and four attacks are legitimate and unsettled. The withdrawn ones include a bubble condition this phase thought it could observe and a count that was an artefact of its own default.
beats.consequence: The attack numbers are in the source against the lines they changed.

beats.claim: The cheapest improvements available to Dula need no new data at all, and governance is what blocks them.
beats.says: Of 49 hinges, 3 close by pointing an existing variable at a series this repository already holds and 5 by a recipe the model already records. 4 would need a download and 2 are governed and will never appear in one.
beats.because: The census found that the cheapest available improvements need no data. Three hinges are closable by pointing an existing variable at a series this repository already holds, and five by a recipe the model already records. Both require editing world_model/, which IN19 holds byte-identical outside a named pierce. Phase 10I declares no pierce, so it reports them and changes nothing. The binding constraint on Dula's coverage here is governance, not information.
beats.consequence: Phase 10I acquired nothing. The list is the output.
beats.question: Which of the three linkage hinges is worth a named pierce to world_model/, and who decides that?

most_consequential_unknown.why_it_limits: Dula's subject is small places and small firms, and every series it holds for them is a sector or national aggregate. A falling mean and a worsening tail are the same observation here.
most_consequential_unknown.would_resolve: a distributional series by income, firm size or credit score — absent for households in the §N census and not closable by any download listed
